gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-yi: Muscular and blunt, College draws every curve with the same heft as its straight stems, leaving generous openings inside. Noto Sans Yi has a deep midsection and rounds left open like an unlatched hook, a gentler voice beneath.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-zanabaza: College gives every curve the weight of a straight stem, right down to the crossbar on its t, which matches the upright. Noto Sans Zanabazar Square follows with wide gaps and a soaring x-height.
gen-dafont-college-gf-onest: Dynamic from the first glance, College gives every curve the full strength of a stem and keeps its counters generous. Onest reads gently over long stretches: short ascenders, big bowls, steady lines.
gen-dafont-college-gf-parkinsans: Blunt and punchy, College builds each curve as sturdy as its stems, with large counters. Parkinsans keeps one stroke thickness throughout, with wide-mouthed letters that stay crisp and lowercase rising close to capitals.
gen-dafont-college-gf-pt-sans-caption: College draws every curve in a single monoline stroke, so its counters stay generous and its manner stays assertive. PT Sans Caption adds unclosed, inviting bowls, and that openness is what lingers most.
gen-dafont-college-gf-questrial: Questrial has a flat, stencil-cut feel, its single-weight strokes sitting in a high band with short stalks above. Questrial gives College's dynamic, authoritative headings a quiet sans companion to lean on.
gen-dafont-college-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Schibsted Grotesk feels approachable, with terminals that never close in. College supplies the weight, every curve as stout as a stem, and that jump from heavy display to big-bowled text is the pair's best trick.
gen-dafont-college-gf-sen: Modern in outlook, Sen traces each lowercase letter with a constant line and lets its curves end before turning inward. College is built to command attention; Sen is built to carry the text.
gen-dafont-college-gf-sintony: Sintony brings a chunky midzone and curves that never clog, beneath College's lines that look traced with one marker tip. Long paragraphs of Sintony would glide by smoothly, nothing clotting.
gen-dafont-college-gf-sofia-sans: College is a dynamic, authoritative display face whose curves match its stems in weight, leaving generous counters. College makes the statement; Sofia Sans, flat in stroke, does the reading.
